title_en: How to Get $100 From H&R Block's New Spruce Banking App in Three Steps
summary_en: Spend smarter, save more, and stay on track with Spruce.
body_en:
From figuring out what’s coming in to where it’s all going, tracking finances is hard. To make matters even worse, banks aren’t always the most transparent and rarely help you understand what’s happening with your money.
Spruce is different. This banking app keeps things real, providing tools to take control of your money, start saving, manage spending, and more. Whether you’ve got $50 or $50,000 in the bank, your path to financial wellness is made easier with Spruce. Plus, it comes with no judgment, no hidden fees, a solid APY high-yield savings rate, $100 welcome bonus [ 4 ], and more. In 2026 especially, there's a general need to track spend more diligently due to high costs on tech and even everyday items, while also finding ways to still get the cool, new things (like the latest Apple Watch or newest LEGO set ) that brings you joy. An app like Spruce can help.
Built by H&R Block, a company known for its financial expertise, Spruce is a mobile banking app designed to help users more easily understand and track their spending patterns. Tools to set goals, check credit scores, budget, and more are all easily accessible directly in the app, letting you manage your money and build better financial habits without any fear of judgment.
Beyond keeping you on top of your finances, Spruce offers savings and spending accounts [1] with no monthly fees, minimum balance requirements, or sign-up fees for a simple, transparent banking experience. That’s a rarity these days. With the spending account, you can receive electronic transfer deposits, set up direct deposit, use mobile check deposits, and even make cash deposits at select retail locations. As for the savings account, the 3.50% APY [2] high-yield savings rate is extraordinary.
Like most bank accounts, Spruce has a debit card that can be used anywhere Mastercard is accepted. No swipe fees or transaction fees are charged when using the card to make purchases, and all in-network ATMs have no withdrawal fee.
With a Spruce savings account, you’ll automatically earn 3.50% APY [2], more than eight times the national average [3]. That applies no matter the amount in your account, thanks to the lack of minimum balance requirements. To make things even better, Spruce has a handy automatic savings tool for easier savings growth.
Danielle is a Tech freelance writer based in Los Angeles who spends her free time creating videos and geeking out over music history.
